scholarships.title: Excellence Scholarship for Bachelor Students (University of St.Gallen)

existing.description: The University of St.Gallen awards Excellence Scholarships to students enrolled in a Bachelor's degree on the basis of merit. The scholarship amount corresponds to the current tuition fees at the Bachelor level for a total of six semesters. It is not open to self-application: the Advice Center for Study Funding identifies enrolled students with an outstanding academic performance in the HSG Assessment Year and invites them to apply. The University of St.Gallen and the Monique Dornonville de la Cour - Stiftung currently fund these Bachelor-level excellence scholarships.
eligibility: Enrolled at the University of St.Gallen in a Bachelor's degree programme
Outstanding academic performance in the HSG Assessment Year
Identified and invited by the Advice Center for Study Funding; an application without an invitation is not possible
Additional selection criteria may be applied depending on the funding source
existing.eligibility_summary: Enrolled students of the University of St.Gallen with an outstanding academic performance in the HSG Assessment Year who are identified and invited by the Advice Center for Study Funding. Self-application is not possible.
benefits: Full Bachelor-level tuition fees for six semesters
Award decided by the relevant committee, in cooperation with the funding foundation
coverage: Tuition fees at the Bachelor level for a total of 6 semesters, at the rate current at the time of award
No living-cost or travel component is stated on the official page

existing.notes: The scholarship is currently awarded by the University of St.Gallen together with the Monique Dornonville de la Cour - Stiftung, in cooperation with the Advice Center for Study Funding. HSG reports in its sustainability report that 41 excellence scholarships worth approximately CHF 450,000 were awarded in 2024, alongside need-based support from the Loan and Scholarship Fund. The page states no single CHF figure for this award because the amount tracks the current Bachelor tuition fee, so funding_amount is left null rather than inventing one.
existing.duration: Six semesters of Bachelor-level tuition fees (three years)
existing.application_period: Invitation-driven. Invitations are issued by the Advice Center for Study Funding to enrolled students with outstanding Assessment Year performance, and applications are submitted by those invitees only.
existing.deadline_display: There is no public application deadline. The Advice Center for Study Funding identifies students with an outstanding academic performance in the HSG Assessment Year and invites them to apply; an application without an invitation is not possible.
existing.program_type: Merit-based university excellence scholarship, invitation only
